courses/math-grade-1/u03-2/double-ten-frame.md. Use the shared frame through day 57. From day 58 offer individual copies only. Draw two frames made from two rows of five cells. Keep the frames away from mental observations.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-2/foldable-ten-strip.md. Fold an individual ten-mark strip after matching every mark to one counter. Use the drawing or the strip instead of cubes; withdraw shared towers on day 64.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-2/teen-retrieval.md. Read one prompt at a time. Keep the day 47 marks for day 48 and rebuild a fresh frame before equations if needed.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-2/ten-build-record.md. Draw or assemble only the teacher’s practice numbers. Use loose marks and folded scraps if pieces are unavailable.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-3/packet-practice.md. Model moving loose pieces on open frames while the ten stays. Use no sealed-packet label or crossed-out evidence card here.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-3/removal-practice.md. Model how the leaving group fits the box. Use large paper pins drawn as diamonds, with no sharp objects. Teacher practice key: the missing change is five.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-3/teen-fact-rounds.md. Cover and check with a partner or do individually during observation. These are practice cards. Keep the private mental set folded separately.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-4/three-group-mats.md. Place intact paper shapes or cubes on separate mats, supplied group labels first. Draw these marked spaces with pencil if needed. Use only named practice quantities.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-4/three-trains.md. Day 54 model. Adult prepares detachable groups. Use paper scraps or copied shapes instead of linking cubes. Connect each original group to its term before joining trains.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-4/grouping-layouts.md. Match all three groups across the two supplied arrangements. The last panel compares the two possible starts for subtraction. Keep the counterexample unscored.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-4/split-and-trace.md. Trace the four already marked as moved, then account for the one remaining. Six, four and one make eleven. Change case when retrying.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/method-comparison.md. Show the same five round, five square and one long clip across both supplied methods. Invite tracing of each piece and use another case for the fresh return.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/three-tag-story.md. Act the scene in order, then pair two with eight. Use fifteen tags in all and preserve all three groups. Patterned scraps or drawn marks substitute for pieces.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/transfer-pattern.md. The first group loses one and the next gains one in each row. Only the two groups change, so all totals are nineteen. Keep the exit slide layout separate.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/ten-making-rounds.md. Use the familiar try, check and retry routine. Mark the group moved or paired before the partner checks. Read every expression aloud and keep records private.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/removal-trace.md. Trace the already separated groups in the model. After one leaves, ten stay. Remove five more and five stay. Do not use the folded exit as practice.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/difference-comparison.md. First compare supplied records. Point to the one extra in the start and keep the removal target fixed. Keep S64’s one-fewer panels separate.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-5/count-up-comparison.md. The two supplied methods belong on separate surfaces. Compare the two leftover dots with the two new counts. Use another case for any retry.
courses/math-grade-1/u03-6/story-role-mats.md. Use with one acted practice scene. Supply the labels and ask children to repair a misplaced label. Use large scraps or sketch the pieces.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-6/mixed-arithmetic-cards.md. Independent practice during private observation or familiar puzzles. Offer paper and no-kit drawn pieces; mark after an independent attempt. Keep the private fact cards apart.

courses/math-grade-1/u03-6/story-fragments.md. Use the familiar day 54 picture after the E66 return. Read each supplied fragment and have partners trace it to its pictured group. No story invention during this practice.

Use the pictures for feedback or record a picture-supported response as shown with help. Score the names separately from the join.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-1/exit-131.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Use the marked quartet for the rule cue. A picture or neutral dictation can supply the rule.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/exit-132.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Use the same drawing for the side marks and the Exit box corner marks.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/exit-box-132.md. Use as the student page Exit box. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Dot the corners on the slip drawing, then clip the box to it.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/exit-133.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Keep both drawings for the separate Exit box.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/exit-box-133.md. Use as the student page Exit box. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Point to the paired exit drawings. Mark the essentials on those drawings. Use the blank space for the change or indicate it on the slip.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/exit-134.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Both marks use the same card. The adult can read color labels or offer a folded paper corner.
courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/exit-stock-135.md. Adult cuts the three large pieces in advance and keeps them sealed until this exit. Use heavy scrap paper at the printed scale.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/exit-135.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Use the separate precut exit stock. Move the circle between the prompts and keep its seam and round outline visible with paper tabs. Clip the mark from the Exit box to the mat.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/exit-box-135.md. Use as the student page Exit box. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Trace or mark on the exit mat, preserving the join already made.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/exit-136.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Retain both extensions for the Exit box. Identify the original flat square for the last cue.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/exit-box-136.md. Use as the student page Exit box. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Use the square from the half slip for the feature mark.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/exit-137.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Collect the first selection before showing the dashed repair. Read the repair as a separate cue.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/exit-box-137.md. Use as the student page Exit box. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Give the rectangle repair after the first selection is sealed.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/exit-138.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Read all the choice words. Collect the labels before showing the indicated shares for the counts. Use section 7.3 field 3 for feedback on the two label marks.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/exit-box-138.md. Use as the student page Exit box. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Read one count cue per picture. Circling a numeral on loose paper can stand in for writing it.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/exit-139.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Keep both comparison marks as descriptive first-teaching evidence.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/exit-box-139.md. Use as the student page Exit box. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Use the circle pair already marked on the slip. Keep the dividing mark on that paper or record the exact dictated words next to it.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/exit-140.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Read the labels before collecting the first response. Then uncover the pair for comparing.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/exit-141.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. All children mark paper. Separately ask the spoken cue in the key, once each to names 19 to 24. Use 45 seconds per child while peers finish.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/exit-142.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Keep both marks on the same clock. Accept a mark showing the hour hand halfway to the next number.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/exit-143.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Link each label to a hand before asking for digits.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/exit-144.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Give both event cues in order. Say the event label and invented-for-practice line aloud.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/exit-145-copy.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Give this first, without the next slip. Collect before giving the clock panel.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/exit-145-clock.md. Print as a half slip. Read the stems and picture labels aloud. Before class set aside key-exits.md for the teacher. Give the clock after collecting the copy. Before class the copy and clock panels can be printed together and separated by an adult.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/r1-attribute-record.md. Print on two sides if needed: sorts on the first side, build and trace on the second. Keep the strip kit private. Read one cue at a time, say the three change labels and provide a loose card for the smaller drawing. Fix the rotated card beside the original after its turn.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/r1-strips.md. Adult precuts three unnumbered strips per child. Keep the same print scale for all three and use distinct paper stock for teaching. Use same-length scrap strips if there is no printer.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/r2-solid-record.md. Give one large cube, noncube rectangular prism, right circular cone and right circular cylinder privately, then a distinctly sized addition. Clean boxes, paper tubes and adult-folded cones substitute for kit stock. Keep joined pieces stable with removable paper tabs. Let the child use the first sketch for the outline cue. File the larger sketch and individual observation together.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/r2-flat-stock.md. Adult precuts the upper four and the two curved pieces below for each child. Hold the extra rectangle at lower right apart until the larger design cue. Provide plain paper tabs. Use traced, adult-cut scraps if there is no printer.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/r2-flat-record.md. Give eight minutes of independent time. Trace the first arrangement before any extension. Keep the first outline on the mat or use tracing paper to move it whole. Retain both records for feedback.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/r3-partition-record.md. Read each cue separately. Use eight independent minutes on 138. Offer the verification overlay only after the original work is collected. Return the marked paper on 140 for dated revision.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/r3-overlays.md. Copy at the same scale as the partition record. Adult precuts duplicate stock. After the independent attempt, use tracing or stack paper copies to compare the child’s regions. Confirm different-looking equal areas with symmetry or decomposition; patches need not be congruent.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/s1-share-supplement.md. Read the labels aloud in mixed order. Use the marked halves and fourths for the comparison, and ask for the other share name after the initial label is saved. Give four minutes for share and size marks, four for labels, three for the final reason, and one to collect. Accept a pointing response recorded on paper. Do not use these diagonal windows in teaching.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/r4-reading-cards.md. Use separately from the independent record. Point to one card at a time. Children read aloud to the teacher; record exact words privately. Four brief readings at 15 seconds each plus 30 seconds to move and log. On 143 the 1:30 reading is descriptive practice only.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/r4-clock-record.md. Give six independent paper minutes outside the child’s oral turn. Keep the cards from other groups and preserve first marks. On 143 use the 10:30 writing and 1:30 drawing as descriptive practice.
courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/s2-clock-supplement.md. Give both read-aloud cues in the four-minute slot. Set aside key-assessments.md for the teacher.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-1/solid-sort-mat.md. Set real pieces on the trays for the hook: a cone alone, a cube and cylinder together. Use plain clean boxes and an adult-made cone and tube when there is no kit. Turn real objects before children sketch them. Leave the trays blank for a partner’s hidden rule.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-1/retrieval-129.md. Use the spoken difference cue from key-practice.md for the six. First handle the real cube and cylinder, then mark the flat shape on this sheet. If the cues are missed, use the different face outlines on day 130.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-1/face-matching.md. During the kindergarten repair slot, match a flat end of a tube or cone and the flat faces of two clean boxes to separate outlines. Make your own matching outlines by tracing the objects if print scale differs. Use only practice objects.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-1/retrieval-130.md. Adult precuts two pieces per child. Give five minutes for a first attempt. After collecting it, use separate copies and the faint rectangle target to demonstrate the half-turn about the midpoint of a longest side.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-1/join-targets.md. On 130 use the rectangular target after collecting the independent retrieval. On 131 use the broad triangle target with new adult-cut stock for the routed ten-minute repair. Cut the additional broad triangle down the center first. Show a half-turn with the two long-side edges meeting when visiting the rectangle target.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-1/solid-construction-mat.md. Use for unscored sketches of joins. Start with a low cylinder and cone, then add a second cylinder. On later days use a different practice pair or trace an outer boundary. Press large paper tabs onto the solids before moving them together.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-1/flat-sort-cards.md. Adult precuts card stock or large scrap copies. Test one supplied feature at a time, or hide one piece in a paper bag for tactile counting. Use the cards individually. Keep the exit quartet separate.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/partial-outline-practice.md. Finish the five-sided fence by adding two segments through a fifth dot, such as the dot at the bottom row between its open ends. Mark an edge and a join on the model. Use tactile cards before private copying.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/triangle-detective-cards.md. Use started examples and edge tests. Complete the triangle at left on anchored equal strips laid at matching angles, then use the starts on this page to practice closure. Keep the narrow and turned independent drawing mats for the exit.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/triangle-practice-strips.md. Adult precuts all three strips. Use the ends as the corners; hold one down and lay the other two to close the figure. Strips of equal length make an equilateral triangle. Keep the unequal R1 strips sealed.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/corner-check-cards.md. Use the folded corner on one outline at a time. Set aside the started open rectangle for the strip build. Turn one, resize a different one and recolor a third. Adult cuts the practice outlines from spare paper.
courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/corner-guide.md. Use one square corner as a feel-and-fit guide. Fold scrap paper edge to edge for a no-print guide. Test each corner separately.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/flat-piece-labels.md. Show the trapezoid and curved pieces individually first. Read labels, then give adult-cut larger copies for construction. Save practice stock for days 135 and 136. Use different sizes, seams and arrangements from the R2 stock.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/first-whole-practice.md. Trace the connected trapezoid and triangle before adding the loose trapezoid. Use a second paper copy of the first whole to slide it. On 136 use this supplied seam to rehearse before independent construction.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/motif-practice-cards.md. Copy each started arrangement from supplied paper pieces. The first has a rectangle, square and triangle. The second has a trapezoid, quarter-circle and half-circle. After copying, slide a tracing into blank drawing space and extend one of these practice designs.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/flat-construction-mat.md. Use only with teaching stock. Keep the first trace on the page to show what moved as one piece. Give the fresh R2 mat and fresh stock separately on day 136.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/fold-practice.md. Adult precuts copies or traces the outlines onto scrap paper. First fold the rectangle so opposite edges meet, then fold across the first crease. On the circle start an oblique fold through the center and fold across it with the first crease’s endpoints touching. Match the paper by stacking.
courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/fold-overlays.md. Print at the same scale as share fold practice. Check that boundaries match before using the fold. Use stacked paper outlines or tracing paper.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/loose-share-cards.md. Adult precuts both pieces of the disk along the centered S-shaped cut. A half-turn maps one piece to the other. On 138 rebuild the rectangle with four detached blocks. On 140 leave a piece out for partner practice and cover earlier worked examples.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/share-label-cards.md. Read each word or short label aloud. Use the cards with loose practice pieces and keep each exit stock separate. One word or pointing is enough to supply a label.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/loose-comparison-pieces.md. Adult precuts the semicircle and two comparable fourths. Put the straight radial sides together with the curved edges facing out to cover the semicircle. Use the long paper strips for the rectangle comparison. Do not display paired marked wholes.
courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/loose-piece-record.md. Trace a detached practice half and mark where the two fourths touch. Keep the exit comparison marks separately as descriptive evidence.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/missing-share-practice.md. After shared worked cards are put away, have the partner name the empty share and draw its boundary on this practice card. Self-check with key-practice.md. The two practice shapes are independent and do not form a comparison pair.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/paper-clock.md. An adult secures and covers the pivot and checks that the hands stay attached. If there is no fastener, use a penciled dial and redraw both hands together at each stage. The long hand shows minutes and the short hand shows hours.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/whole-hour-practice.md. Build the 8:00 model with the hands from the paper clock. Draw both hands for 2:00. On the two started examples the digits tell which missing hand to draw. The key is for the teacher.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/clock-motion-cards.md. Adult cuts the sequence into cards and mixes the two faces. Use the unnumbered circle and strip first. Then put the printed half-past-four and five-o’clock faces in order while moving the paper hands forward. The minute hand travels halfway around from the top to the bottom. The hour hand moves only halfway to the next number.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/half-hour-practice.md. Show the face at half past four with the :30 label. For 3:30 model setting the two hands from the digits, then cover the model. Use the partially shown face for hand-label practice. Never display the exit or record faces.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/school-event-practice.md. Read the event labels and invented-for-practice line. The first practice face has the hands swapped. Have children correct the face before checking the supplied digits. Draw the missing hands for the second card.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/started-clock-review.md. Recall the two hand jobs from a started practice face. Complete the omitted hand. Use clean boxes and an adult-folded cone for the joined-build practice and check its seam while turning.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/quiet-practice.md. Offer familiar corner-checking and paper counting while joining records. Children can check four square corners and find how many marks altogether. The class uses the quiet practice key after its independent attempt. No new score comes from this sheet.

courses/math-grade-1/u07-2/key-practice.md. Keep with the teacher.
courses/math-grade-1/u07-3/key-practice.md. Keep with the teacher. On 140 make the relevant answers available privately after the practice attempt.
courses/math-grade-1/u07-4/key-practice.md. Keep with the teacher and use only the familiar practice key on 146.
